column2: B6: ChangeZoneAll GainControl$ moves the card under its OWNER and emits ControlChange only after the battlefield MoveZone (effects/zone_changeall.go:248 then :271; same order in effects/zone_change.go:1481), so Soul Snuffers' ETB trigger is controlled by its owner and Obelisk Spider ("you put") never triggers. CR 110.2a, 603.3a.

B6: ChangeZoneAll GainControl$ emits ControlChange after the battlefield MoveZone (effects/zone_changeall.go:248 then :271), so the returned creatures' ETB triggers are controlled by their owner, and the owner's Obelisk Spider triggers instead of none. CR 110.2a, 603.3a.

B7: trample lethal damage ignores damage already marked: rules/combat.go:2090 uses need := e.Toughness(bid), so in the regular damage step the double striker assigns 3 more to an indestructible blocker that already has lethal damage instead of trampling over. CR 702.19c, 510.1c.

B9: Mode$ BecomesTarget ignores FirstTime$ True (rules/trigmatch/actions.go:234-307 never reads it), so Glyph Keeper counters every spell or ability that targets it, not only the first each turn. CR 603.2 (trigger condition as printed).

B10: DestroyAll ValidCards$ Card.blockedBySourceThisTurn matches nothing: effects/filter_word.go:1471 knows only blockedBySource (live o.BlockedBy, :898-901), so Defiant Vanguard's end-of-combat delayed trigger destroys itself but not the creature it blocked.

B11: Token AtEOT$ ExileCombat is not implemented (effects/ateot.go:37-52 emits a Note and keeps the token), so Geist of Saint Traft's Angel survives end of combat. CR 511.2 (delayed trigger at end of combat).

B13: one TokenAmount$ 2 creation fires Woodland Champion's Mode$ ChangesZoneAll line once PER token (rules/trigger_match.go:1538 batches ChangesZoneAll only while e.zoneBatchOpen, which token creation never opens), and each per-event trigger reads TriggerCount$Amount as 0 (no TriggerAmount bound for the per-event ChangesZoneAll path in rules/trigger_referents.go), so no counters are put. CR 603.2c (one batch event).
